recommendation.basis: Rank by number of common institution codes with full-window Nacional coverage in each candidate's primary line, then internal gaps and global missing months; exact single-line matching breaks ties. Health's primary line is Salud y Hospitalización; all Accident & Health sublines are reported separately. Code-set overlap is a coverage comparison, not a join of financial records. The mean completeness fraction is also reported: it can favor a different line than the absolute complete shared cohort size. Completeness does not prove signal quality. Volatility of reported levels is confounded by cumulative semantics and changing panels.
blockers: Confirm Saldo definition, gross/net basis and monetary unit scale with official CNBS evidence.
Confirm whether Nacional/Extranjera denote native amounts or already converted presentation values; no mixed-currency aggregation.
Approve an explicit cross-resource label concordance; no joins exist in this phase.
Understand unreported rows versus zero and reporting-entry/exit changes before constructing a stable panel.
Historical values may be revised; current snapshots are not point-in-time vintages.
